description: This file is a PHP source code file defining a Controller class 'Review' for handling product reviews in the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It includes methods for viewing, listing, and submitting product reviews, with dependencies on models, language files, and external extensions for CAPTCHA and pagination.

classes.name: Review
classes.description: Controller class for handling product review display and submission in the OpenCart platform.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the display of the product review page, including loading language files, managing product ID, and setting up view data.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Handles the AJAX request to submit a new product review, including validation, captcha verification, adding review to the database, and returning JSON response.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Retrieves and displays a list of reviews for a specific product, handling pagination.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches the reviews for a product based on product ID and pagination, returning HTML view.
